It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Polite, intense, and careful with boundaries. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they want to be chosen, not merely useful so every new guest is a test they hate administering. If that truth surfaces at Guild inn back room, First Night, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
